meta.title: Firefly typesetting
meta.description: Lays replies out to read well on a phone: formulas on lines of their own, the final answer boxed, worked solutions in short headed steps, and key points, methods and common mistakes in coloured callouts. A Bot with a drawing tool draws the graph of a function it explains. Callouts are coloured in recent Firefly builds and show as quotes elsewhere. The plugin's settings can turn callouts off or add rules of your own.
